summary: The candidate quickly diagnosed the correct root cause — the sweep releasing original unit count instead of remaining count — stated it as a clear mechanism before editing, made a targeted fix, verified with a passing test run, and closed with an accurate restatement of the bug. The session was efficient and correct but light on narration detail and edge-case verification.

dimensions.analysis: The candidate moved straight from reading the failing test to diagnosing the mechanism without asking any clarifying questions, but the test output and test body were unambiguous enough (expected five, got eight, shipped units returning) that there was little genuine ambiguity to resolve. Given the short session and immediate correct diagnosis, there is no clear opportunity to judge whether they skipped necessary clarification or simply did not need it.

Before touching code, the candidate explicitly named the mechanism: the sweep releases the original unit count instead of the remaining count, which is precisely the root cause. This is a mechanism-level hypothesis, not just a vague location, and it directly matches the ground truth.

The candidate narrated the key diagnostic moment (expected vs actual units) and stated their hypothesis aloud before editing, giving an interviewer a thread to follow. However, narration was sparse overall — nothing was said during the actual edit or about which fields/lines were being changed in sweep.ts.

The edit to src/sweep.ts was made immediately after stating the hypothesis and was saved once, consistent with a single targeted fix rather than scattered thrashing. There is no visible narration of the specific code change, but the timeline shows a coherent single edit-save cycle that aligns with the stated plan.

The candidate re-ran the test suite after the fix and confirmed it passed before ending the session, rather than declaring victory purely from the code change. There is no evidence of additional edge-case checking (e.g., confirming full-release holds still work), so verification was present but minimal.

The candidate closed by restating the root cause — the sweep returning the original count as phantom stock — which correctly connects the fix to the failure mechanism. This matches the ground truth almost verbatim, though it is a brief restatement rather than a deeper explanation of why the remaining-count fix generalizes safely.
